transcript.t: Amy, what is that machine in the school workshop?
It is a 3D printer. It can make small plastic toys layer by layer.
A little, but it is getting cheaper every year, so many schools can afford one now.
Not yet. It makes simple things, like a cup or a toy car.
I would like to invent something useful.
Me too. Maybe a laptop that never runs out of power!
